newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin has second meeting with Chirac on cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Jospin has second meeting with Chirac on cabinet.

text.p: New French Socialist Prime Minister Lionel Jospin began a second meeting with conservative President Jacques Chirac on Wednesday on the formation of a broad left cabinet including two communist ministers.

Jospin arrived at the Elysee presidential palace shortly after the head of the cabinet office, a non-partisan civil servant, went to meet Chirac, suggesting the announcement of the composition of the new government was imminent.
